content.user_title: Discover Website Sitemaps and Public URLs
content.value_statement: Finding a website's public pages manually can be slow and incomplete. SitemapKit discovers sitemap files and extracts their listed URLs through MCP tools.
actual_capabilities: Find sitemap files by checking robots.txt, common sitemap paths, and sitemap indexes.
Extract URLs from a sitemap URL supplied by the user.
Collect URLs across discovered sitemaps with a single full crawl request.
Report whether a URL result was truncated by the configured maximum.
Surface remaining SitemapKit quota information from tool responses.
limitations: Requires a configured SitemapKit MCP server and a valid SitemapKit API key.
Only returns URLs that are available through the target website's sitemaps.
Full crawl and discovery use the domain and ignore URL paths.
URL volume and request frequency are limited by the SitemapKit plan and rate limits.

use_cases.title: Map a website before research
use_cases.description: Discover public page URLs before reviewing a company, product, or documentation site.

use_cases.title: Review sitemap coverage
use_cases.description: Find sitemap files and inspect listed URLs when checking website structure and SEO coverage.

use_cases.title: Collect public documentation pages
use_cases.description: Extract URLs from a known sitemap to create a scoped list for documentation analysis.

prompt_templates.title: Find a sitemap
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the sitemap files for https://example.com and list where each one was found.

prompt_templates.title: Extract sitemap URLs
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract URLs from https://example.com/sitemap.xml and include last modified dates when available.

prompt_templates.title: List public pages
prompt_templates.prompt: Get all public pages for https://example.com. Report the total, whether results were truncated, and the first 50 URLs.

prompt_templates.title: Audit sitemap structure
prompt_templates.prompt: Discover sitemaps for https://example.com, summarize each sitemap type and URL count, and identify whether the response was truncated.

output: The response identifies each sitemap source and URL.

output_examples.input: How many public pages does https://example.com have?
output: The crawl reports the total URL count.
The result states whether the URL list was truncated.
Remaining monthly quota is shown when provided by the service.

best_practices: Use a full URL with https or http when calling a SitemapKit tool.
Start with sitemap discovery when you do not have a direct sitemap URL.
Check truncation and quota fields before requesting more URLs.
anti_patterns: Do not expect this skill to find pages omitted from public sitemaps.
Do not use a path with full crawl when you need a path-specific sitemap extraction.
Do not request more URLs than needed because plan quotas and rate limits apply.

faq.question: What does SitemapKit do?
faq.answer: It discovers sitemap files and extracts public URLs listed in those sitemaps.

faq.question: Do I need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. The SitemapKit MCP server requires a valid SitemapKit API key.

faq.question: Can it crawl every page on a website?
faq.answer: It returns URLs available through discovered sitemaps, not every page reachable by a browser crawler.

faq.question: Which tool should I use for a known sitemap?
faq.answer: Use extract_sitemap with the exact sitemap URL.

faq.question: Why are some results missing?
faq.answer: The sitemap may omit pages, the result may be truncated, or the plan may limit URL volume.

faq.question: How do I handle a rate limit?
faq.answer: Wait until the retry time returned by the service, then try again.
